name: RoleHint
productStatus: working prototype; hiring-outcome uplift and product-market fit not independently validated
description: Career decision prototype: screen jobs for explicit eligibility constraints, compare requirements against real experience, and identify what to verify before applying.
audience: professionals managing an urgent or targeted job search
userProblems: difficulty seeing which job-search effort works

frequencyBasedWorkflows.name: Review a job
frequencyBasedWorkflows.purpose: paste real job text or load an explicitly fictional sample; check work setup, geography and salary from stated text

frequencyBasedWorkflows.name: Clarify personal fit
frequencyBasedWorkflows.purpose: select relevant job requirements and add your own achievements without invented evidence

frequencyBasedWorkflows.name: Decide next action
frequencyBasedWorkflows.purpose: copy a Review / Verify / Skip summary including unresolved questions for the employer

capabilities: hard eligibility checks before semantic fit
explicit verified, review and gap evidence states
notCapabilities: proven uplift or validated product-market fit
privacyAndControl: The public demo runs without a server, cookie persistence or external requests, beyond static assets; pasted job text and notes stay in the current browser session. The connected backend is a separate environment.
demoData: Fictional sample postings are clearly labeled. Visitors may also paste actual job descriptions, processed entirely in browser memory.
demoDescription: Static browser demo: paste a job description, set remote/geography/salary preferences, inspect extracted requirements, self-select experience, and copy a decision checklist. Local text heuristics only: no network fetch, AI inference, login, or real vacancy verification.
